guitar.notes: Folk singer-songwriter, plays acoustic guitar but no documented iconic/signature instrument.

tone.target: dry fingerpicked acoustic folk, intimate and warm
tone.profile: dry fingerpicked acoustic folk, intimate and warm
tone.summary: Clean, warm acoustic folk tone using a clean preamp and minimal reverb to simulate fingerpicked arpeggios.
corrections: remove Fender Twin and Vox AC30 references

rig.name: Harry Chapin - Cats In The Cradle (Acoustic Version) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Gentle compression to even out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is used gently, avoiding heavy artifacts as requested. Ideal for acoustic warmth.

blocks.purpose: Bypass drive section to maintain clean acoustic character.
Provides a clean, warm American tone suitable for folk and acoustic simulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best available clean amp model to avoid vintage tube coloration while maintaining warmth.

blocks.purpose: Simulates a small, intimate acoustic setting with minimal coloration.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen for its clean voicing and compact sound, fitting the 'intimate' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Slight boost in bass and mids to enhance the body resonance of acoustic arpeggios.
blocks.gap: Used for subtle tonal shaping, enhancing warmth without sounding artificial.

blocks.purpose: Bypass wah to keep the tone natural and uncolored.
Bypass modulation to maintain the dry, natural acoustic sound.
Subtle echo to add depth without sounding like a typical delay effect.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly (low mix/feedback) to enhance the sense of space, not as a primary effect.

blocks.purpose: Minimal room ambience to give the arpeggios a sense of space without sounding artificial or overly wet.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used at very low mix levels, respecting the 'minimal' requirement.

improvements.summary: Replace the current IR with a highly natural acoustic simulation cabinet to better capture the intimate, dry sound of fingerpicked arpeggios.

proposals.recommendedAsset: High-quality Acoustic Simulation IR (e.g., specific mic on a parlor guitar)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too 'electric' and lacks the natural, dry resonance of an acoustic source.
